Thanks for the forward, Naomi. A couple of quick asks to clear the PO gate: 
1) Please ask TemplarTech for one additional piece of evidence that ties the EIN to the legal entity — IRS CP 575 or SS-4 confirmation is ideal; a bank letter with TIN is acceptable if it shows the legal name AND EIN. The SS-4 PDF they attached looks like a formation confirmation but we need a signed/IRS-issued confirmation or an official bank letter.
2) We also need a signer-authority document (could be the company resolution or an email from a corporate officer) showing Jasmine Lee is authorized to sign supplier documents. The name/title on the W-9 must match that authority doc.

If they can provide both as PDFs, we can override the automated flag and proceed with PO creation. If they need guidance on acceptable formats I can paste a short template.
